session_summary: A patient consulted a doctor about persistent headaches, high blood pressure, and palpitations. The doctor prescribed medication, recommended lifestyle changes, and scheduled follow-up tests and appointments.

proposed_actions.title: Measure Blood Pressure
proposed_actions.description: Measure blood pressure twice daily and record values in a notebook.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want you to measure your blood pressure at home twice a day, in the morning and in the evening, and note the values in a notebook.

proposed_actions.title: Get Blood Tests Done
proposed_actions.description: Complete blood tests including cholesterol, blood sugar, creatinine, and ionogram.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Please do them by Wednesday, on the spot.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Electrocardiogram
proposed_actions.description: Schedule and complete an electrocardiogram at the polyclinic.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: The assistant Maria will schedule your electrocardiogram and give you the printed prescription.

proposed_actions.title: Take Prescribed Medication
proposed_actions.description: Take amlodipine five milligrams once daily in the morning.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll prescribe you amlodipine five milligrams, one tablet in the morning.

proposed_actions.title: Reduce Coffee Intake
proposed_actions.description: Reduce coffee consumption to at most one cup per day in the morning.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Please reduce your coffee to at most one a day, in the morning.

proposed_actions.title: Limit Salt Intake
proposed_actions.description: Reduce salt consumption as much as possible.

decisions: Prescribe amlodipine five milligrams once daily in the morning.
Schedule follow-up appointment on Friday, 13th of November, at ten o'clock.
risks: If blood pressure exceeds 180 or symptoms like numbness, blurred vision, or chest pain occur, call 122 immediately.
follow_up_questions: When will the blood pressure notebook be completed and submitted?
When will the blood test results be available?
